Gzip KB per entry (minified ESM bundle, framework peers external). Stage 4 ceilings (plans 06 §6, 07 §6 and 08 §6, R5): core/foundation 15, core/date 12, adapter date entries 31, adapter root = sum of the subpath ceilings. Values are measured +15% rounded up to 0.5 KB, capped at the ceiling. Raising one needs a line in the PR description saying why. core/time is over the plan's 8 KB ceiling: both panel layouts, single and range, live in one controller. core/datetime is a hair over the plan's 6 KB (6.10 KB measured): range panels and inputs live beside the single ones. Plan 11 review: availability on cells, slots and per-resource backgrounds raised the base calendar entries within the plan's 21 KB core ceiling (core/calendar-base 21, vanilla 28, react and vue 31). Stage 5d (plan 12 R4): the opt-in recurrence pack has its own entries (`calendar-recurrence`) and a combined `calendar-packs` entry with resourceViews; each is capped at +6 KB over the configuration it extends (core/calendar-recurrence 27, core/calendar-packs 31; adapter recurrence entries at base + 6).
